dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I've waited five months here! Five months! (blotted out) Choiseul sent me here to (blotted out)!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Ms. Cassigneul, in the name of the Iudex, I beg you! Please send another letter to the Maison Cardinalice. They once promised an 'imminent start to work'!"

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Cassigneul's Reply
dialogues.text: "Thank you for your message. I have already... done all I can to escalate this matter. Please be patient."

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Cassigneul's Reply
dialogues.text: "And please do not worry about your salaries. If necessary, I will pay them personally. I ask you to... keep your faith in the future of Lumidouce Harbor."
